name: aurora-marker
title: Aurora Marker
author: jmagar <https://github.com/jmagar>
description: Timeline and status marker primitive for chat separators, bordered events, icons, and accessible status content.
docs:
Aurora Marker primitive for conversation timeline state. Use the separator variant for temporal dividers, border for state transitions, and role=status when content announces live activity.

Registry dependencies: aurora-tokens, aurora-components.
